note: Membership lists by trade agreement, as featured in the 2024 Kenya trade policy review. Names are written to match the partner-country labels used in ITC Trade Map downloads; the 'aliases' entries cover variant spellings (e.g. 'United Republic of Tanzania'). Kenya is the reporting country and is therefore excluded from every bloc. EAC is a subset of COMESA, and both are subsets of AfCFTA, so the same trade is counted under each of those market-access umbrellas.

agreements.name: East African Community (EAC) Customs Union
agreements.blurb: Preferential tariff rates inside the EAC Customs Union (Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Somalia, Uganda and Tanzania).

agreements.name: Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA)
agreements.blurb: Free Trade Area covering 21 states across eastern and southern Africa, headquartered in Lusaka, Zambia.

agreements.name: African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA)
agreements.blurb: Single continental market of roughly 1.3 billion people across African Union members; every African market except Kenya is counted.

agreements.name: African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) - United States
agreements.blurb: Duty-free access to the US market for qualifying Kenyan apparel and agricultural exports (reauthorised to 31 December 2028), framed by the US-EAC and US-COMESA TIFAs.

agreements.name: EU-UK Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) / ACP Markets
agreements.blurb: Duty-reduced, quota-free access for Kenyan exports to the European Union under the 2023 EPA (plus the UK-Kenya EPA and the ACP/Cotonou successor preferences).

agreements.name: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) Markets
agreements.blurb: Preferential duty treatment in developed partners outside the EU and the US: Australia, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, Norway and Switzerland. (EU and AGOA/US are captured separately above.)

agreements.name: Bilateral Trade Agreement Partners
agreements.blurb: Countries with signed bilateral trade agreements with Kenya that are not already captured by the EAC, COMESA, AfCFTA, EU-EPA or AGOA groupings above.
